MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_RIGHT_FIST_POWER.desc: Whenever you play a card, gain 1 Vigor
Take double damage from enemies. Enemy damage to allies is halved\nFor every 20 attack damage you accumulate, gain 1 stack of next-turn Energy; other allies gain 1 stack of next-turn draw and 10 stacks of Witchification
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_PERIODIC_FUSION_POWER: Every {Amount} turns, gain 1 stack of 【Complex Emotion】 and 1 random basic [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow]
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_LOSEENGRY.title: Next-turn Energy Loss
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_LOSEENGRY.description: At start of turn, lose Energy equal to this power's stacks
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_HEREHIRO_POWER.title: Here's Hiro!
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_HEREHIRO_POWER.descri: Each stack of this power reduces hand size by 1\nCards removed from combat by Erosion are stored here. When this power is removed, return these cards to your hand
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_THIRTEEN_WATER_INTEL_: [jitter][color=#cccccc]「You, who lost your mind and became wreckage, would only kill everyone even if you returned to the past」[/color][/jitter]\nOn death, revive: all players heal to full and negative powers are removed; self removes other negative powers, max HP increases, heal to full and gain 50 Block\nWhen attacked and losing HP, 20% chance to give the attacker 1 stack of [b]Intel[/b]; each death increases the chance by 10%, up to 5 triggers per turn
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_THIRTEEN_WATER_PLAYER: [jitter][color=#cccccc]「To kill the 【Witch】, they seem to have developed a drug with the same effect......」[/color][/jitter]\nWhen 13 stacks are reached, remove this power and allies gain 1 [b]Thirteen Waters[/b]
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_THIRTEEN_WATER_TASK_P: Deal at least {DamageTarget} damage and gain at least {BlockTarget} Block this turn.\nSuccess: gain 20 Block.\nFailure: the Boss gains 10 stacks of [b]Witchification[/b] and 20 Block, and records 1 task failure (each failure makes the next attack deal extra damage)

Deal at least {DamageTarget} damage and gain at least {BlockTarget} Block this turn.\nSuccess: gain 20 Block.\nFailure: the Boss gains 10 stacks of [b]Witchification[/b] and 20 Block, and records 1 task failure (each failure makes the next attack deal extra damage)
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_UNCONTROLLED_JUSTICE_: [jitter][color=#CC6666]「In this world, I have become wreckage wandering the prison————」[/color][/jitter]\nAfter each intent is executed, each stack has a 20% chance to execute the same intent one extra time
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_FUSION_STAND_POWER.de: When the Boss executes an intent, the phantom executes one extra intent
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_THREE_CARD_OMEN_POWER:
Play three cards of the same type consecutively to gain a power (once only)
Attack: Mind-Cost Draw
Skill: Dancing Men
Power: Final Farewell
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ENCHANTMENT_CONVERGEN:
Choose an ally. Each turn, when any of your [color=#339966]【[/color][color=#cc9966]Jud[/color][color=#6699cc]gment[/color][color=#339966]】[/color] enchantment counters reach 5, it is anchored;
afterwards, the extra effects of that enchantment counter are also gained by the chosen ally
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_GEINIZHENGYIPOWER.des: This turn, whenever an ally draws 1 card and recovers {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, give them 1 stack of Justice
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_SILENT_POWER.title: Silence
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_SILENT_POWER.descript: Right-click or two-finger tap to consume 13 stacks of [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color]: all enemies immediately execute their current intents, [color=#6666cc]permanently lose 1 Strength[/color], and gain the [color=#6666cc]【Silenced】[/color] mark; then choose 1 replacement intent; each replacement intent requires [color=#6666cc]rotating selection[/color]. Each use increases the value of the next [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color] replacement intent by 1 (does not affect [color=#6666cc]【Brainwash】[/color]).
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_SILENCED_POWE: Mark: this enemy was suppressed by [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color]. No effect; removed at the start of this enemy's turn.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_TRACING_POWER: When the next [color=#6666cc]【Blank Page】[/color] generates a card, copy the generated card
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_INDEX_PAGE_PO: When [color=#6666cc]【Blank Page】[/color] generates a card, {Amount} extra options appear
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_NOAH_ASSIST_P: This turn, you may use [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color] or [color=#6666cc]【Brainwash】[/color] via right-click or two-finger tap for free. At [blue]end of turn[/blue], give enemies rewritten by this free use {RewrittenNymPower:diff()} stacks of [blue]【Noah Kinoshita's Magic】[/blue]; if no enemy was rewritten, give all enemies {NoRewriteNymPower:diff()} stacks.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_BORROWING_PER: The first {Amount} cards from recorded pools played each turn are exhausted after being played, and draw 1 [color=#6666cc]card[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_NO_ANSWER_POW: At [color=#6666cc]end of turn[/color], if you played no [b]Attack cards[/b] this [color=#6666cc]turn[/color], gain {Amount} stacks of [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_OPPRESSIVE_SI: [color=#6666cc]Each turn[/color], the 1st time [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color] is consumed, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}; afterwards, instead draw 1 [color=#6666cc]card[/color].\nEvery 4th cycle
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_INTERROGATION: After the next [b]Attack card[/b] is played, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_JUDGMENT_EVE_: During this combat, each time an enemy's intent is rewritten, record 1.\nAt [color=#6666cc]start of turn[/color], if at least 3 have been recorded, consume up to {Amount} records: draw that many [color=#6666cc]cards[/color] and gain that much {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_MOVIE_PROMISE: At [color=#6666cc]start of next turn[/color], return {Amount} promised cards to your hand and let them be playable once for free this [color=#6666cc]turn[/color]; then generate 1 card from their pool that is playable once for free this [color=#6666cc]turn[/color] and has [b]Ethereal[/b] and [b]Exhaust[/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_BUTTERFLY_TAL: When a marked enemy next deals damage to you, record up to {Amount} points of [color=#6666cc]damage[/color] as [blue]【Red Butterfly】[/blue] healing. If you already have [blue]【Red Butterfly】[/blue], add to it; otherwise, heal at [color=#6666cc]start of next turn[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_DELAYED_CARD_: At [color=#6666cc]start of next turn[/color], return {Amount} stored cards to your hand.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_PRISON_IS_HOM: Whenever you played no [b]Attack cards[/b] [color=#6666cc]last turn[/color], enter [color=#6666cc]【The Cell】[/color] at [color=#6666cc]start of this turn[/color].\nGain {Amount:energyIcons()} upon entering [color=#6666cc]【The Cell】[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_CELL_POWER.de: [color=#6666cc]Each turn[/color], the first [b]Skill card[/b] played is placed on top of the draw pile instead, and its cost is reduced by 1 until played.\nAt [color=#6666cc]end of turn[/color], gain {Amount} stacks of [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color] and retain up to 1 hand card.\nIf you play an [b]Attack card[/b], leave [color=#6666cc]【The Cell】[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_PEACE_OF_MIND:
Max 3 stacks.
At the start of your turn, each stack randomly triggers: gain 1 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} or draw 1 [color=#6666cc]card[/color].
When taking any unblocked damage, lose all [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color].
If you lose 2 or more stacks at once, choose a hand card to gain [b]Replay 1[/b].
If [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color] is at 3 stacks at the end of 2 consecutive of your [color=#6666cc]turns[/color], lose it and gain [color=#6666cc]【Isolated】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_ISOLATED_POWE: Cannot gain [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color];\nyou draw 1 fewer [color=#6666cc]card[/color] at [color=#6666cc]start of your turn[/color], hand size is halved, and you lose 1 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}\nRemoved at [color=#6666cc]end of turn[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_AVERTED_GAZE_: Whenever you lose [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color], the next [b]Attack card[/b] is played twice.\n[color=#6666cc]Once per turn[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_DELETED_STRES: The next {Amount} attacks deal 50% less damage.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_GROUP_CHAT_SM: Whenever an ally plays a card for the first time in their turn, apply {Amount} stacks of [color=#6666cc]【Strange Smell】[/color] to a random enemy.\nTriggers once per ally per turn.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_STRANGE_SMELL: When taking attack damage, remove 1 stack and spread 50% of the unblocked damage to all other enemies. If there are no other enemies, gain 1 stack of [b]Weak[/b] instead.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_CONCEIVING_NO: [color=#6666cc]Each turn[/color], the first time each ally plays a [b]rare[/b] card, add a temporary copy costing 1 to your hand. It gains [b]Exhaust[/b].\nIf this power comes from an upgraded card, the copy costs 0 instead.\nAfter you play a conceived copy, gain 1 [b]Strength[/b] and 1 [b]Dexterity[/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_CLUTCH_SLEEVE: When a recorded card is played at [color=#6666cc]next turn[/color], gain 1 stack of [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_COUNT_TO_THRE: [color=#6666cc]This turn[/color], for every 3 counting cards played, draw 1 [color=#6666cc]card[/color].\nWhen gaining this power, for each stack of [color=#6666cc]Reassurance[/color], every 2 counting cards played reduces the cost of the next counting card by that amount
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_COUNTDOWN_OF_: [color=#6666cc]This turn[/color], after the 3rd counting card is played, it returns to your hand, costs 0, and is exhausted on its next play.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_DOOR_GAP_BLOC: When a recorded card is played, gain extra Block.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_DOOR_GAP_CONF: If you play no [b]Attack[/b] [color=#6666cc]this turn[/color], automatically play a copy of the recorded card at [color=#6666cc]end of turn[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_SOFT_AGREEMEN: If the recorded card was not played [color=#6666cc]this turn[/color], gain {Amount} stacks of [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color] at [color=#6666cc]end of turn[/color]; afterwards, playing that card restores HP.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_SYNCED_BREATH: [color=#6666cc]This turn[/color], when the next consecutive cards of the same type reach the specified count, gain 1 stack of [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color] and take a card of a different type from the draw pile.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_UNNOTICED_POW: [color=#6666cc]This turn[/color], after the next non-[b]Attack[/b] card is played, if no enemy intends to attack, gain 1 stack of [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color] and draw a card
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_LIE_POWER.des: When you right-click or two-finger tap [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color] to make a monster act immediately, remove all [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color] and [color=#9999ff]【Lie】[/color]; gain {VigorPerLie:diff()} stacks of [b]Vigor[/b] per [color=#9999ff]【Lie】[/color] stack,\nand gain 1 stable multi-hit [b]Attack[/b] card costing 0, randomly generated from the pool recorded by [color=#6666cc]【Anan's Sketchbook】[/color], playable now.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_LIE_POWER.sma: After right-clicking or two-finger tapping [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color], remove all [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color] and gain Vigor and a 0-cost multi-hit [b]Attack[/b] card.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_VIGOR_STAYS_P: The next {Amount} times [b]Vigor[/b] would decrease this turn, it does not decrease instead.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_DRAFT_REWRITE: At [color=#6666cc]start of turn[/color], you may choose 1 card from your hand; then a random character card pool is designated, and you may choose 1 card from it to transform your hand card into. If that pool has been recorded by [color=#6666cc]Anan's Sketchbook[/color], or is successfully recorded through this effect, add a copy of the transformed card to your deck. If the Sketchbook has already recorded 3 pools, you may first remove 1 card belonging to a recorded pool from your deck and forget that pool.
At [color=#6666cc]start of turn[/color], a random character card pool is designated, and you may rewrite 1 hand card; if that pool is recorded or successfully recorded, copy it into your deck.
Choose a hand card to rewrite
Choose the rewrite card from the designated pool
Choose a card to remove and forget its pool
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_BRAINWASH_POW: Right-click or two-finger tap to directly rewrite all enemies' current intents without consuming [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color].\nAfter forced brainwash, gain 1 stack of [color=#6666cc]【Brainwash Backlash】[/color]

Right-click or two-finger tap to directly rewrite all enemies' current intents without consuming [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color].\nAfter forced brainwash, gain 1 stack of [color=#6666cc]【Brainwash Backlash】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_BRAINWASH_BAC:
1st acquisition: your current [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color] decreases by 1.
2nd acquisition: add 1 [color=#6666cc]【Blank Page】[/color] to the draw pile.
3rd acquisition: lose all [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color], gain {WithPower:diff()} stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b], and 【Brainwash】 now requires consuming [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color] while this power is at 3+ stacks.
Currently 【Brainwash】 requires consuming {NextBrainwashSilenceCost:diff()} stacks of [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color]
Afterwards, for every {SilenceTaxThreshold:diff()} stacks of [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color] you accumulate, lose [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color] equal to this power's stacks.
The next Brainwash consumes {NextBrainwashSilenceCost:diff()} stacks of Silence
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_AAM_BACKLASH_: 【Brainwash Backlash】 has already been reduced this combat
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_DOOR_NOT_LOCK:
The next time you would lose [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color] from unblocked damage, lose only 1 stack and gain 1 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
If it does not trigger before [color=#6666cc]end of turn[/color], gain 1 stack of [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_SEALED_PAGE_P: After right-clicking or two-finger tapping to consume 13 stacks of [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color] to rewrite an intent, gain {Amount} Block and add 1 [color=#6666cc]【Blank Page】[/color] to your hand.\nIf the source card is upgraded, gain [color=#6666cc]【Blank Page+】[/color] instead.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_PAGE_CORNER_P: For every 4 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} accumulated and spent, add 1 [color=#6666cc]【Blank Page】[/color] to your hand.\nIf the source card is upgraded, gain [color=#6666cc]【Blank Page+】[/color] instead.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_SILENT_AMPLIF: Every time you replace {Rewrites:diff()} monster intents, upgrade this combat's replacement intent pool
Every time you replace {Rewrites:diff()} monster intents, upgrade this combat's Silence-replacement intent pool
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_BACKSTAGE_RES:
At [color=#6666cc]start of turn[/color], trigger [color=#cc99ff]【Audition】[/color]: consume your current [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color] stacks and randomly trigger that many effects.
1: Generate a temporary 0-cost exhaust card from a recorded pool
2: Gain [color=#6666cc]【Blank Page+】[/color]
3: Consume {RequiredSilenceCost:diff()} stacks of [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color] and trigger [color=#6666cc]【Brainwash】[/color]'s rewrite; if Silence is insufficient or cannot rewrite, gain [color=#6666cc]【Blank Page】[/color]
4: Draw 1 [color=#99ccff]card[/color] and make a random hand card gain 1 stack of [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color] after being played
If the source card is upgraded, trigger the first randomly rolled effect one extra time

At the start of each turn, randomly trigger [color=#cc99ff]【Audition】[/color] effects based on [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color] stacks.\nCurrently, triggering [color=#6666cc]【Brainwash】[/color] rewrite requires consuming {RequiredSilenceCost:diff()} stacks of [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_FAKE_DEATH_AC: [color=#6666cc]This turn[/color], the next time you take fatal damage, survive with 1 HP instead and gain a Page.\nIf it does not trigger, gain 1 [color=#6666cc]【Blank Page】[/color] at [color=#6666cc]end of turn[/color].
The next fatal damage instead leaves you with 1 HP; if not triggered, gain [color=#6666cc]【Blank Page】[/color] at end of turn.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_MARGARET_VOIC: Record the current intents of all enemies when applied.\nAfter you are affected by a recorded intent, you are immune to the 2nd instance of the same recorded intent, and this Magic is removed
Immune to the 2nd instance of HP loss from the same recorded intent, and remove this.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_LEIA_INDUCTIO: This enemy's intent has been forcibly induced into another intent of the same effect type
Intent has been induced; removed at end of turn.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_TRUTH_POWER.title: Truth
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_TRUTH_POWER.descripti:
When you grant a card [color=#CC6666]Transmigration[/color], it also gains [color=#ffcc66]Truth[/color].
The 'gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} when auto-played' effect of [color=#ffcc66]Truth[/color] is suppressed.
Every 3 cards with the [color=#ffcc66]Truth[/color] component auto-played: gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and draw 2 cards.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_TRUTH_POWER.smartDesc: Every 3 cards with the [color=#ffcc66]Truth[/color] component auto-played: gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and draw 2 cards.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_PEACE_OF_MIND: Choose a hand card to gain Replay 1
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ORIGINALSIN_FORGIVENE: Records the number of times [color=#00ffff]Forgiveness[/color] triggered this combat (hidden)
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ORIGINALSIN_RESOLVE_C: Records the total times [color=#ff0000]Punish[/color] or [color=#00ffff]Forgiveness[/color] triggered this combat (hidden)
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ORIGINALSIN_RAIYA_EXT:
[gold]While not in hand[/gold]:
your [gold]damage[/gold] and [gold]Block[/gold] gain have a {Amount}% chance to trigger an additional time
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_IGNITE_POWER.title: Ignite
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_IGNITE_POWER.descript:
At the [color=#cccccc]start or end of your turn[/color], attack {Amount} random targets (friend or foe, based on stacks).
Hitting an enemy: deal [b]damage equal to half your stacks[/b] (min 1); all allies gain 1 [color=#6666cc]Block[/color]; if that enemy lacks [color=#6666cc]Vulnerable[/color], apply 1 Vulnerable.
Hitting an ally: deal 1 [color=#6666cc]damage[/color] to it instead, then this power gains 2 stacks.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_THIRTEENTH_LISTENER_P: Whenever you trigger a Fire Color Chain, consume {Amount} more Fire Color and draw {Amount} card(s).
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_MIXED_CONCLUSION_POWE: The first time each turn you trigger a Fire Color Chain, gain {Amount} Energy and draw {Amount} card(s).
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_KUAN_SHU_YIN_JI_POWER: Whenever you "forgive" an Original Sin, gain +1 stack. On your next turn's draw phase, draw as many cards as your {Amount} stacks, then clear them.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_NI_NI_ZHI_ZHENG_POWER: Each time you "punish" an Original Sin, gain +1 stack and 1 Strength per stack.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_XING_JIA_JIA_SHEN_POW: The 1st Original Sin curse you play each turn costs -1, gains Exhaust, and returns to your hand.
For the rest of combat, whenever [color=#ff0000]Embers[/color] burns {Threshold} card(s), gain {Amount} [b]Strength[/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_XUN_HUAN_FA_DIAN_POWE: When you forgive or punish an Original Sin, if it would enter the Discard/Exhaust pile, put it on top of your Draw pile instead; then randomly trigger a card effect (forgive or punish) as many times as the number of Original Sin cards in your deck.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ABILITY_NULLIFY_POWER:
Remove all positive powers from the target.
They are restored as they were at end of turn.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_UNDEATH_POWER.title: Undeath
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_UNDEATH_POWER.descrip:
At the [color=#6666cc]start of each turn[/color], lose HP equal to this power's stacks (can be [color=#6666cc]Blocked[/color]).
When you would take fatal [color=#6666cc]damage[/color], survive at 1 HP and lose 1 stack of this power instead.
While your [color=#6666cc]HP[/color] is below {Amount}%,
being attacked gives the attacker 1 stack of [b]【Immortal Flame】[/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_IMMORTAL_FLAME_BRAND_:
When it deals [color=#6666cc]damage[/color] to a player (including Blocked damage),
lose that much [color=#6666cc]HP[/color]. Never wears off.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_BOUND_PROMETHEUS_POWE: This turn, all your Fire Color consumes count as the same color and do not trigger Chains; each consume deals 6 damage to that enemy.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_DRAGON_WITCH_POWER.de:
This [color=#6666cc]turn[/color], dealing [color=#6666cc]damage[/color] gives you 1 stack of [b]【Suspicion】[/b],
and you are immune to its [b]Strength[/b] loss.
At [color=#6666cc]end of turn[/color], convert all [b]【Suspicion】[/b] into 5× [b]【Witchification】[/b],
then deal [color=#6666cc]damage[/color] to all enemies equal to 2× the converted stacks (3× if upgraded).
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_EXPLOSION_MAGIC_USED_:
You have already played 「Explosion Magic」 this combat.
Only 1 can be played per combat.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_CRIME_AND_PUNISHMENT_:
You have already played 「Crime and Punishment」 this turn.
Can only be played once per turn.
Whenever everyone has played 5 [color=#cccccc]cards[/color] in total, every character randomly triggers 1 extra [color=#6666cc]【Judgment】[/color] enchantment effect (1 of 15 at random)
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_EMOTION_TRANSFER_POWE: This turn, whenever a chosen ally plays a card, you gain 1 [rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow]
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_FRIENDSHIP_SEEKING_PO: When an ally plays a card you gave with the [gold]Gift[/gold] mark, you also play the same card once
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_FALSELY_ACCUSED_POWER:
Lost at [color=#6666cc]start of turn[/color].
When you take unblocked damage from a monster, spend Hiro's [b]【Perjury】[/b] equal to that amount (1 [color=#CC6666]【Justice】[/color] counts as 5 [b]【Perjury】[/b] when short), then heal that much HP
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_I_AM_CORRECT_ACTION.t: 「I Am the One Who Is Right」
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_I_AM_CORRECT_ACTION.d:
[color=#ff99cc]Click to choose[/color] 1 character (including you) and give them 1 [b]【Falsely Accused】[/b] (lost at [color=#6666cc]start of turn[/color]).
Can be clicked any number of times each turn
